name: design-verdict-gate
description: Validate a design pass: subject-grounded, brief wins over defaults, conversational tone, accessible floor (responsive, focus, reduced-motion).

grounded.description: true: design grounded in subject matter

brief_pins.description: true: brief pins the visual direction

default_used.description: true if a templated default was used on a free axis

tone_ok.description: true: plain verbs, sentence case, end-user naming

accessible.description: true: responsive, keyboard focus, reduced motion, harmonious color
